reasons: The rule's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer; the cited paragraph (p0066) is an independent-contractor/no-agency clause that imposes no solicitation, hiring or inducement restriction, so classifying the document as compliant at the preferred position is correct.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — nothing is over-flagged and the text is left unchanged.

The failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are correctly explained as artifacts of there being no restrictive covenant to measure, not evidence of a deviation; for a preferred position of 'no non-solicit', these regex heuristics cannot pass by construction.

The rationale is accurate and appropriately records the fallback and walk-away thresholds as internal negotiation guidance should the Vendor later introduce such a covenant, which is proper use of a retained compliant finding.
